_comment: An alpha boar's tusk gore: physical and bleed damage to the nearest enemy within a 1.1-unit ring every 60 ticks, 16 HP plus 2.5 per level. Half the Boar's cadence at nearly three times the hit — the elite's threat is the single blow, not the grind. The bleed tag means Thick Hide, which this mob also drops, reduces it. All values placeholder.
name: AlphaBoarGore
